report:
Fresh reassessment of the complete product_availability claim and its one ordinary implementation association and one TODO test. Verified src/inspector.rs and service_spec.rs exactly match the historical source snapshots; the prior rationale is corroborating context, not new execution evidence. In the current captured inspector source, selected_symbol and external_selected_symbol return ProductDescriptors from their catalogs. product_descriptor supplies the opaque string ID, label, and percent-encoded product URL through the same mechanism for both symbol origins. Local catalogs advertise identity, source only with a span, and concrete-ir/signature/diagnostics/typed-ir only for local functions. External catalogs advertise identity, signature only for Fn/Trait/Struct/Enum, and items only for Mod/Enum/Trait; other variants omit unsupported products. The synthetic local root has no locator and thus an empty product list. Catalog construction uses symbol kind/span metadata and descriptor assembly; actual source text, function signature/body, external signature/items reflection, and product-page construction are in separate product dispatch paths. These observations account for positive availability, IDs/labels/URLs, non-eager catalog construction, common local/external mechanism, and unsupported-product absence at the inspected source level.
The complete associated test set is solely sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_inspector_inspection_product_availability. Its empty body is not behavioral evidence; its explicit TODO requires association and review of local/external catalog tests asserting exact positive lists and prohibiting product-detail reads during construction. This is a justified, specific remaining coverage prerequisite: meaningful local/external selection fixtures must assert descriptors/unsupported omissions and observe that catalog selection does not demand advertised products. No ordinary associated test currently establishes this end-to-end guarantee. Accepting that existing TODO preserves the deferred status and does not certify implemented/tested completeness. All helpers relied on for this limited catalog/dispatch source assessment are in the initially captured whole inspector file; review policy was additionally captured with review read. I executed review start/read and source comparison, and am recording this report; I ran no behavior tests or build. The coordinator-reported 321 passing sage-meta tests and root build are separate prior execution evidence, not substitutes for the missing catalog assertions. No changes to the explicit deferral accounting are requested.
